title: 2dImReg
description: 2D image registration tool for 3D+time datasets, aligning images on a slice-by-slice basis to a specified base image.

dx_file.description: File containing dx registration parameters in pixels/mm

dy_file.description: File containing dy registration parameters in pixels/mm

psi_file.description: File containing psi registration parameters in degrees

oldrms_file.description: File containing the volume RMS error for the original dataset

newrms_file.description: File containing the volume RMS error for the registered dataset
